t.why: Officially a permanently neutral state. It sells large amounts of gas to China by pipeline.
t.rel: Officially permanently neutral, it joins no military alliances. Drawing on huge gas reserves, it sells large amounts of gas to China by pipeline.
t.know: It is known for the 'Door to Hell', a gas crater that has been burning for more than 50 years.
t.etext: It has some of the world's largest natural gas reserves, and most exports go to China. It publishes almost no economic data.
